selector.rationale: The abdominal ultrasonography and contrast-enhanced CT findings of a thick-walled, predominantly anechoic lesion with low-level internal echoes and a homogeneous echogenic area, along with the presence of turbid fluid upon aspiration, support the diagnosis of an infected non-parasitic cyst.

rejected.label: Infected Hepatic Cyst
rejected.why: Less specific than infected non-parasitic cyst

rejected.label: Pyogenic liver abscess
rejected.why: Hepatic abscess is a broader term and less specific

rejected.label: Simple Hepatic Cyst
rejected.why: Presence of infection and complex features on imaging

rejected.label: Hepatic Abscess
rejected.why: Although a possible diagnosis, the specific imaging features and aspiration results better support infected non-parasitic cyst
